claim.operational_target: Compare outcome-blind committed PCFM probabilities with population, historical-constant, and profile-LLM probabilities on at least 100 later human choices from one person and one declared domain.
non_claims: The model recovers thoughts, beliefs, values, consciousness, or a causal cognitive mechanism.
Performance transfers to another person, domain, option set, context, or time window.
Local signatures prove that independent real-world organizations controlled every role.
alternatives: The person's historical base rate is sufficient.
A profile-conditioned LLM is at least as predictive as PCFM.
Any observed gain is chance variation or post-outcome alteration.
claim.scope: One registered person, binary-choice domain, feature schema, option set, exact scenario set, and prospective collection window.

identifiability.distinguishing_evidence: Four probability vectors and exact scenario content are signed and independently registered before a complete later human-outcome ledger is scored by paired NLL.
unidentified_questions: Whether the registry disclosed every planned or completed trial.
Whether nominally distinct signing roles are organizationally independent.
Which observationally equivalent internal process produced the person's answers.
Whether a finite scenario set represents open-domain cognition.

evidence.completeness_boundary: Code verifies supplied signatures, chronology, exact counts, and content; an external append-only registry must establish real completeness and trusted time.

computation.deployment_kernel: The exact probability arrays signed in the plan are scored with evaluate_probability_array and per-question binary log loss.
computation.selection_kernel: No model selection occurs after registration; all four fixed methods are compared.
computation.uncertainty_scope: Paired per-question NLL mean and fixed Newey-West/Bartlett standard error with floor(n^(1/3)) lags in unique outcome-time order; no person-population or model-selection uncertainty claim.

downstream_consumers: Python plan, receipt, score, verification, and persistence API

results.summary: 15/15 focused prospective-pilot tests passed in 1.371s after two hostile-audit repair rounds.
Completion gate is expected to refuse confirmatory status because no real future holdout, verified base eligibility, or global/local applicability evidence exists.

remaining_limitations: No real-person outcome data have been collected.
A local HMAC implementation cannot provide an external append-only registry or trusted timestamp.
The protocol evaluates bounded forecasting, not semantic or causal cognitive recovery.
Profile-LLM forecasts must be produced and committed by an external model/tool before outcomes.
